# لایف روس (LifeRuss)

> Multilingual study-abroad advisory for Russia, plus Iran–Russia freight and trade/sourcing landings. Domain: liferuss.com. Not an e-commerce store.

Place this file at the site root (https://liferuss.com/llms.txt). The theme also serves `/llms.txt` dynamically from Theme Options so the live site stays in sync.

Organization: لایف روس
Alternate names: LifeRuss, Life Russ
Languages:
- fa — Persian (default, RTL) https://liferuss.com/
- ru — Russian (LTR) https://liferuss.com/ru/
- ar — Arabic (RTL) https://liferuss.com/ar/
- en — English (LTR) https://liferuss.com/en/
hreflang: fa, ru, ar, en, x-default → fa
